name: daylanes
description: Connects Codex to Daylanes, the local Mac time tracker for consultants: ask about hours, agent usage and costs per client and project, and write the daily project Diary. Requires the Daylanes app on macOS.

interface.longDescription: Daylanes is a Mac app that tracks consultant time, coding-agent usage and costs per client and project, entirely on your Mac. This plugin lets Codex answer questions such as how many hours and how much agent spend went into a client this month, find agent work with no project, and write the daily project Diary from your agent's own sources. Everything runs locally through the command-line tool inside Daylanes.app; nothing is sent anywhere by the plugin. Requires Daylanes on macOS (daylanes.app/download).
interface.defaultPrompt: How many hours and how much agent spend went into each client this week?
